Timing of IPEDS Provisional and Final Data Releases

![Image 4](https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/datacenter/images/icon_close.svg)

Quality control procedures and institution follow-up continue two to three months after a collection period closes. Missing data are imputed due to nonresponse to entire survey components or items. The provisional release of the edited and imputed data will include a set of WEB tables that formerly appeared in IPEDS First Look reports as well as a Data Release Memo that summarizes response rate information for each survey. The final data release is available after institutions have had a chance to revise their data in the following year. Final data are not issued with a set of WEB tables and a Data Release Memo.

The timing of the releases can vary somewhat depending on the nature of the internal process, but generally will follow this timetable:

| Collection Period | Survey Components | Collection closes | Provisional data | Final (Revised) data |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| FALL | IC, C, E12 | November | Approximately 7 months after collection closes | Approximately 7 months after institutions have revised their data the following year |
| WINTER | ADM, GR, SFA, OM | March |
| SPRING | EF, F, HR, AL | April |
| _WEB Tables and Data Release Memo_ | Yes | No |

The current review process for the data releases began with the 2018-19 IPEDS survey year and continues to undergo improvements. However, approval of the data release is subject to multiple steps in the review process and unanticipated delays can occur. The goal of NCES is to maintain or improve the timeliness of data release on an annual basis.

How provisional and final data are used by various Data Tools

![Image 5](https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/datacenter/images/icon_close.svg)

| Data Tool | Usage |
| --- | --- |
| Data Trends (Trend Generator) | Provisional released data are used for the current year. Final data are used where both are available |
| Survey Data Complete Data Files | Provisional and final data files are included in the zip files for years where both provisional and final have been released. |
| Survey Data ACCESS Data Base | Provisional released data are used for the current year. Final released data are used when both are available. Historical provisional data bases are not available. |
| Survey Data Custom Data Files Compare Institutions Statistical Tables Summary Tables | Provisional released data are used for the current year. Final data are used when available, but users are given the option to use provisional data. |
| Data Feedback Report | Data feedback reports are only created when data are provisionally released. Historic reports are available but are not recreated using final/revised data. |
| Look Up an Institution (Institution Profile) | Profiles are only based on the most current provisionally released data. |
| Look Up an Institution (Reported Data) | Historically the reported data tool contained only provisionally released data. Final data have recently been loaded for IPEDS collection years 2014-15 through 2021-22. |

IPEDS data, including provisional release data and final release data, adhere to rigorous quality control procedures established by NCES. Data are imputed for nonresponding institutions. Provisional release data are used for First Look web tables. Final release data include revisions to the provisional release data that have been made by institutions during the subsequent data collection year. While the final release data offer the most up to date data, these data may not match tables from the First Look web tables based on provisional release data.

Timing of IPEDS Provisional and Final Data Releases

![Image 4](https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/datacenter/images/icon_close.svg)

Quality control procedures and institution follow-up continue two to three months after a collection period closes. Missing data are imputed due to nonresponse to entire survey components or items. The provisional release of the edited and imputed data will include a set of WEB tables that formerly appeared in IPEDS First Look reports as well as a Data Release Memo that summarizes response rate information for each survey. The final data release is available after institutions have had a chance to revise their data in the following year. Final data are not issued with a set of WEB tables and a Data Release Memo.

The timing of the releases can vary somewhat depending on the nature of the internal process, but generally will follow this timetable:

| Collection Period | Survey Components | Collection closes | Provisional data | Final (Revised) data |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| FALL | IC, C, E12 | November | Approximately 7 months after collection closes | Approximately 7 months after institutions have revised their data the following year |
| WINTER | ADM, GR, SFA, OM | March |
| SPRING | EF, F, HR, AL | April |
| _WEB Tables and Data Release Memo_ | Yes | No |

The current review process for the data releases began with the 2018-19 IPEDS survey year and continues to undergo improvements. However, approval of the data release is subject to multiple steps in the review process and unanticipated delays can occur. The goal of NCES is to maintain or improve the timeliness of data release on an annual basis.

How provisional and final data are used by various Data Tools

![Image 5](https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/datacenter/images/icon_close.svg)

| Data Tool | Usage |
| --- | --- |
| Data Trends (Trend Generator) | Provisional released data are used for the current year. Final data are used where both are available |
| Survey Data Complete Data Files | Provisional and final data files are included in the zip files for years where both provisional and final have been released. |
| Survey Data ACCESS Data Base | Provisional released data are used for the current year. Final released data are used when both are available. Historical provisional data bases are not available. |
| Survey Data Custom Data Files Compare Institutions Statistical Tables Summary Tables | Provisional released data are used for the current year. Final data are used when available, but users are given the option to use provisional data. |
| Data Feedback Report | Data feedback reports are only created when data are provisionally released. Historic reports are available but are not recreated using final/revised data. |
| Look Up an Institution (Institution Profile) | Profiles are only based on the most current provisionally released data. |
| Look Up an Institution (Reported Data) | Historically the reported data tool contained only provisionally released data. Final data have recently been loaded for IPEDS collection years 2014-15 through 2021-22. |

IPEDS data, including provisional release data and final release data, adhere to rigorous quality control procedures established by NCES. Data are imputed for nonresponding institutions. Provisional release data are used for First Look web tables. Final release data include revisions to the provisional release data that have been made by institutions during the subsequent data collection year. While the final release data offer the most up to date data, these data may not match tables from the First Look web tables based on provisional release data.

Timing of IPEDS Provisional and Final Data Releases

![Image 4](https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/datacenter/images/icon_close.svg)

Quality control procedures and institution follow-up continue two to three months after a collection period closes. Missing data are imputed due to nonresponse to entire survey components or items. The provisional release of the edited and imputed data will include a set of WEB tables that formerly appeared in IPEDS First Look reports as well as a Data Release Memo that summarizes response rate information for each survey. The final data release is available after institutions have had a chance to revise their data in the following year. Final data are not issued with a set of WEB tables and a Data Release Memo.

The timing of the releases can vary somewhat depending on the nature of the internal process, but generally will follow this timetable:

| Collection Period | Survey Components | Collection closes | Provisional data | Final (Revised) data |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| FALL | IC, C, E12 | November | Approximately 7 months after collection closes | Approximately 7 months after institutions have revised their data the following year |
| WINTER | ADM, GR, SFA, OM | March |
| SPRING | EF, F, HR, AL | April |
| _WEB Tables and Data Release Memo_ | Yes | No |

The current review process for the data releases began with the 2018-19 IPEDS survey year and continues to undergo improvements. However, approval of the data release is subject to multiple steps in the review process and unanticipated delays can occur. The goal of NCES is to maintain or improve the timeliness of data release on an annual basis.

How provisional and final data are used by various Data Tools

![Image 5](https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/datacenter/images/icon_close.svg)

| Data Tool | Usage |
| --- | --- |
| Data Trends (Trend Generator) | Provisional released data are used for the current year. Final data are used where both are available |
| Survey Data Complete Data Files | Provisional and final data files are included in the zip files for years where both provisional and final have been released. |
| Survey Data ACCESS Data Base | Provisional released data are used for the current year. Final released data are used when both are available. Historical provisional data bases are not available. |
| Survey Data Custom Data Files Compare Institutions Statistical Tables Summary Tables | Provisional released data are used for the current year. Final data are used when available, but users are given the option to use provisional data. |
| Data Feedback Report | Data feedback reports are only created when data are provisionally released. Historic reports are available but are not recreated using final/revised data. |
| Look Up an Institution (Institution Profile) | Profiles are only based on the most current provisionally released data. |
| Look Up an Institution (Reported Data) | Historically the reported data tool contained only provisionally released data. Final data have recently been loaded for IPEDS collection years 2014-15 through 2021-22. |

IPEDS data, including provisional release data and final release data, adhere to rigorous quality control procedures established by NCES. Data are imputed for nonresponding institutions. Provisional release data are used for First Look web tables. Final release data include revisions to the provisional release data that have been made by institutions during the subsequent data collection year. While the final release data offer the most up to date data, these data may not match tables from the First Look web tables based on provisional release data.

Timing of IPEDS Provisional and Final Data Releases

![Image 4](https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/datacenter/images/icon_close.svg)

Quality control procedures and institution follow-up continue two to three months after a collection period closes. Missing data are imputed due to nonresponse to entire survey components or items. The provisional release of the edited and imputed data will include a set of WEB tables that formerly appeared in IPEDS First Look reports as well as a Data Release Memo that summarizes response rate information for each survey. The final data release is available after institutions have had a chance to revise their data in the following year. Final data are not issued with a set of WEB tables and a Data Release Memo.

The timing of the releases can vary somewhat depending on the nature of the internal process, but generally will follow this timetable:

| Collection Period | Survey Components | Collection closes | Provisional data | Final (Revised) data |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| FALL | IC, C, E12 | November | Approximately 7 months after collection closes | Approximately 7 months after institutions have revised their data the following year |
| WINTER | ADM, GR, SFA, OM | March |
| SPRING | EF, F, HR, AL | April |
| _WEB Tables and Data Release Memo_ | Yes | No |

The current review process for the data releases began with the 2018-19 IPEDS survey year and continues to undergo improvements. However, approval of the data release is subject to multiple steps in the review process and unanticipated delays can occur. The goal of NCES is to maintain or improve the timeliness of data release on an annual basis.

How provisional and final data are used by various Data Tools

![Image 5](https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/datacenter/images/icon_close.svg)

| Data Tool | Usage |
| --- | --- |
| Data Trends (Trend Generator) | Provisional released data are used for the current year. Final data are used where both are available |
| Survey Data Complete Data Files | Provisional and final data files are included in the zip files for years where both provisional and final have been released. |
| Survey Data ACCESS Data Base | Provisional released data are used for the current year. Final released data are used when both are available. Historical provisional data bases are not available. |
| Survey Data Custom Data Files Compare Institutions Statistical Tables Summary Tables | Provisional released data are used for the current year. Final data are used when available, but users are given the option to use provisional data. |
| Data Feedback Report | Data feedback reports are only created when data are provisionally released. Historic reports are available but are not recreated using final/revised data. |
| Look Up an Institution (Institution Profile) | Profiles are only based on the most current provisionally released data. |
| Look Up an Institution (Reported Data) | Historically the reported data tool contained only provisionally released data. Final data have recently been loaded for IPEDS collection years 2014-15 through 2021-22. |

IPEDS data, including provisional release data and final release data, adhere to rigorous quality control procedures established by NCES. Data are imputed for nonresponding institutions. Provisional release data are used for First Look web tables. Final release data include revisions to the provisional release data that have been made by institutions during the subsequent data collection year. While the final release data offer the most up to date data, these data may not match tables from the First Look web tables based on provisional release data.

Timing of IPEDS Provisional and Final Data Releases

![Image 4](https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/datacenter/images/icon_close.svg)

Quality control procedures and institution follow-up continue two to three months after a collection period closes. Missing data are imputed due to nonresponse to entire survey components or items. The provisional release of the edited and imputed data will include a set of WEB tables that formerly appeared in IPEDS First Look reports as well as a Data Release Memo that summarizes response rate information for each survey. The final data release is available after institutions have had a chance to revise their data in the following year. Final data are not issued with a set of WEB tables and a Data Release Memo.

The timing of the releases can vary somewhat depending on the nature of the internal process, but generally will follow this timetable:

| Collection Period | Survey Components | Collection closes | Provisional data | Final (Revised) data |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| FALL | IC, C, E12 | November | Approximately 7 months after collection closes | Approximately 7 months after institutions have revised their data the following year |
| WINTER | ADM, GR, SFA, OM | March |
| SPRING | EF, F, HR, AL | April |
| _WEB Tables and Data Release Memo_ | Yes | No |

The current review process for the data releases began with the 2018-19 IPEDS survey year and continues to undergo improvements. However, approval of the data release is subject to multiple steps in the review process and unanticipated delays can occur. The goal of NCES is to maintain or improve the timeliness of data release on an annual basis.

How provisional and final data are used by various Data Tools

![Image 5](https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/datacenter/images/icon_close.svg)

| Data Tool | Usage |
| --- | --- |
| Data Trends (Trend Generator) | Provisional released data are used for the current year. Final data are used where both are available |
| Survey Data Complete Data Files | Provisional and final data files are included in the zip files for years where both provisional and final have been released. |
| Survey Data ACCESS Data Base | Provisional released data are used for the current year. Final released data are used when both are available. Historical provisional data bases are not available. |
| Survey Data Custom Data Files Compare Institutions Statistical Tables Summary Tables | Provisional released data are used for the current year. Final data are used when available, but users are given the option to use provisional data. |
| Data Feedback Report | Data feedback reports are only created when data are provisionally released. Historic reports are available but are not recreated using final/revised data. |
| Look Up an Institution (Institution Profile) | Profiles are only based on the most current provisionally released data. |
| Look Up an Institution (Reported Data) | Historically the reported data tool contained only provisionally released data. Final data have recently been loaded for IPEDS collection years 2014-15 through 2021-22. |

IPEDS data, including provisional release data and final release data, adhere to rigorous quality control procedures established by NCES. Data are imputed for nonresponding institutions. Provisional release data are used for First Look web tables. Final release data include revisions to the provisional release data that have been made by institutions during the subsequent data collection year. While the final release data offer the most up to date data, these data may not match tables from the First Look web tables based on provisional release data.

[Data Release Cycle Info](javascript:changePermissionOpenWrapper('release-cycle-info')) [How provisional and final data are used by various Data Tools](javascript:changePermissionOpenWrapper('how-data-are-used')) Timing of IPEDS Provisional and Final Data Releases ![Image 4](https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/datacenter/images/icon_close.svg) Quality control procedures and institution follow-up continue two to three months after a collection period closes. Missing data are imputed due to nonresponse to entire survey components or items. The provisional release of the edited and imputed data will include a set of WEB tables that formerly appeared in IPEDS First Look reports as well as a Data Release Memo that summarizes response rate information for each survey. The final data release is available after institutions have had a chance to revise their data in the following year. Final data are not issued with a set of WEB tables and a Data Release Memo. The timing of the releases can vary somewhat depending on the nature of the internal process, but generally will follow this timetable: | Collection Period | Survey Components | Collection closes | Provisional data | Final (Revised) data | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | FALL | IC, C, E12 | November | Approximately 7 months after collection closes | Approximately 7 months after institutions have revised their data the following year | | WINTER | ADM, GR, SFA, OM | March | | SPRING | EF, F, HR, AL | April | | _WEB Tables and Data Release Memo_ | Yes | No | The current review process for the data releases began with the 2018-19 IPEDS survey year and continues to undergo improvements. However, approval of the data release is subject to multiple steps in the review process and unanticipated delays can occur. The goal of NCES is to maintain or improve the timeliness of data release on an annual basis. [Data Release Cycle Info](javascript:changePermissionOpenWrapper('release-cycle-info')) [How provisional and final data are used by various Data Tools](javascript:changePermissionOpenWrapper('how-data-are-used')) Timing of IPEDS Provisional and Final Data Releases ![Image 4](https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/datacenter/images/icon_close.svg) Quality control procedures and institution follow-up continue two to three months after a collection period closes. Missing data are imputed due to nonresponse to entire survey components or items. The provisional release of the edited and imputed data will include a set of WEB tables that formerly appeared in IPEDS First Look reports as well as a Data Release Memo that summarizes response rate information for each survey. The final data release is available after institutions have had a chance to revise their data in the following year. Final data are not issued with a set of WEB tables and a Data Release Memo. The timing of the releases can vary somewhat depending on the nature of the internal process, but generally will follow this timetable: | Collection Period | Survey Components | Collection closes | Provisional data | Final (Revised) data | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | FALL | IC, C, E12 | November | Approximately 7 months after collection closes | Approximately 7 months after institutions have revised their data the following year | | WINTER | ADM, GR, SFA, OM | March | | SPRING | EF, F, HR, AL | April | | _WEB Tables and Data Release Memo_ | Yes | No | The current review process for the data releases began with the 2018-19 IPEDS survey year and continues to undergo improvements. However, approval of the data release is subject to multiple steps in the review process and unanticipated delays can occur. The goal of NCES is to maintain or improve the timeliness of data release on an annual basis. [Data Release Cycle Info](javascript:changePermissionOpenWrapper('release-cycle-info')) [How provisional and final data are used by various Data Tools](javascript:changePermissionOpenWrapper('how-data-are-used')) Timing of IPEDS Provisional and Final Data Releases ![Image 4](https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/datacenter/images/icon_close.svg) Quality control procedures and institution follow-up continue two to three months after a collection period closes. Missing data are imputed due to nonresponse to entire survey components or items. The provisional release of the edited and imputed data will include a set of WEB tables that formerly appeared in IPEDS First Look reports as well as a Data Release Memo that summarizes response rate information for each survey. The final data release is available after institutions have had a chance to revise their data in the following year. Final data are not issued with a set of WEB tables and a Data Release Memo. The timing of the releases can vary somewhat depending on the nature of the internal process, but generally will follow this timetable: | Collection Period | Survey Components | Collection closes | Provisional data | Final (Revised) data | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | FALL | IC, C, E12 | November | Approximately 7 months after collection closes | Approximately 7 months after institutions have revised their data the following year | | WINTER | ADM, GR, SFA, OM | March | | SPRING | EF, F, HR, AL | April | | _WEB Tables and Data Release Memo_ | Yes | No | The current review process for the data releases began with the 2018-19 IPEDS survey year and continues to undergo improvements. However, approval of the data release is subject to multiple steps in the review process and unanticipated delays can occur. The goal of NCES is to maintain or improve the timeliness of data release on an annual basis.
